add_missing_foreign_key_indexes_for_srk_database
statements:
do $$
declare r record; idx_name text;
begin
  for r in
    select distinct ns.nspname schema_name, rel.relname table_name, att.attname column_name
    from pg_constraint fk
    join pg_class rel on rel.oid=fk.conrelid
    join pg_namespace ns on ns.oid=rel.relnamespace
    join lateral unnest(fk.conkey) with ordinality cols(attnum,ord) on true
    join pg_attribute att on att.attrelid=rel.oid and att.attnum=cols.attnum
    where fk.contype='f'
      and ns.nspname='public'
      and (rel.relname like 'srk_%' or rel.relname='service_bookings')
      and not exists(
        select 1 from pg_index ix
        where ix.indrelid=rel.oid and ix.indisvalid and ix.indisready
          and ix.indpred is null and ix.indexprs is null
          and ix.indkey[0]=att.attnum
      )
  loop
    idx_name:=left('fk_'||r.table_name||'_'||r.column_name,48)||'_'||
      substr(md5(r.table_name||'.'||r.column_name),1,8);
    execute format('create index if not exists %I on %I.%I (%I)',
      idx_name,r.schema_name,r.table_name,r.column_name);
  end loop;
end $$;

insert_all_previously_approved_electrician_and_painter_rates
statements:
insert into public.srk_service_rates(
 category_id,service_type_id,skill_level_id,
 technician_hourly_rate,helper_hourly_rate,rate_status,
 effective_from,change_reason
)
select c.id,null,l.id,v.technician_rate,v.helper_rate,'approved',
       clock_timestamp(),'Previously user-approved SRK ELECTRONIC hourly rate; helper optional as specified'
from (values
 ('electrician','basic',100::numeric,0::numeric),
 ('electrician','residential_office',125::numeric,75::numeric),
 ('painter','basic',100::numeric,50::numeric),
 ('painter','expert',150::numeric,75::numeric),
 ('painter','master',225::numeric,100::numeric)
) as v(category_code,level_code,technician_rate,helper_rate)
join public.srk_service_categories c on c.category_code=v.category_code
join public.srk_skill_levels l on l.category_id=c.id and l.level_code=v.level_code
where not exists(
 select 1 from public.srk_service_rates r
 where r.category_id=c.id and r.skill_level_id=l.id
   and r.service_type_id is null and r.rate_status='approved'
);

rows.name: hold_unconfirmed_electrician_rates_as_draft
statements:
update public.srk_service_rates r
set rate_status='draft',
    change_reason='Held as draft: current canonical checklist marks Electrician Basic and Residential/Office rates as pending confirmation; do not expose to customers until explicitly approved'
from public.srk_service_categories c
join public.srk_skill_levels l on l.category_id=c.id
where r.category_id=c.id and r.skill_level_id=l.id
  and c.category_code='electrician'
  and l.level_code in ('basic','residential_office')
  and r.service_type_id is null
  and r.change_reason='Previously user-approved SRK ELECTRONIC hourly rate; helper optional as specified';
